d: In Bihar’s Education Department, salaries allowances were allegedly paid to fake teachers and in some cases the salary allowances were increased far beyond the approved amount. This is not an isolated case in Bihar as there are three different cases that have emerged from the state from different districts that include Nawada, Patna, and Bhagalpur. Government officers have been arrested for adding unauthorised allowances to salaries, using an official login ID to make these unauthorised entries, and processing payments in the names of teachers who never actually existed.
